text:
sam_sales: Quick heads-up  Prospect (NordicBank) requires EU-only POC for regs: tenant must be pinned to eu-west-1, no outbound connections to US subproc, and BYO-KMS (AWS in eu-west-1). Need a concise price delta and a short SOW. Can we support? @leo_se @anya_sec

leo_se: Yes we can support. Two clarifications: 1) hard pin (no cross-region failover) or soft-affinity? 2) will they accept exported metrics stored in EU-only analytics, or must we disable external telemetry entirely?

sam_sales: Legal requested hard pin and all telemetry kept in EU. They will not accept metrics going to a SaaS in US.

anya_sec: Understood. BYO-KMS (AWS KMS) is acceptable; for fintech they typically want HSM-backed keys. We'll include that in our attestation template. We'll also produce a filtered subprocessor list that excludes any US-hosted services. If we must remove a telemetry vendor, eng will need 1-2 weeks to swap to EU-only alternatives.

kyle_ops: Implementation plan: spin up Dedicated eu-west-1 cluster, tenant_pin config with failover disabled, integrate with customer's CMK (validate policies and access), and replace telemetry with EU-only stack. Additional infra cost for dedicated reservation + isolation.

leo_se: Draft SOW snippet (pseudo yaml):
```
- Provision Dedicated cluster: region=eu-west-1, reserved capacity
- Tenant pin: tenant_id=nordic-xyz, regions_allowed=["eu-west-1"], failover=disabled
- BYO-KMS onboarding: validate AWS KMS CMK in eu-west-1, HSM attestation
- Subprocessor attestation & contract amendment
- QA: no-egress validation and signed report
- Knowledge transfer + runbook
```

sam_sales: Pricing ballpark vs hosted? they need to complete MSA sign-off with a delta.

kyle_ops: Ballpark: hosted baseline = A. Dedicated EU-only + BYO-KMS + removing US telemetry ~ +25-35% depending on commit term and whether we can reuse some infra. 12mo commit can reduce another ~5%. Also apply monthly minimum for reserved pool.

leo_se: Timeline for a 3-week POC start: Week0 finalize SOW & pricing; Week1 provision cluster & KMS exchange; Week2 onboard tenant + QA; Week3 validation & cutover. Risk: infra lead time for dedicated capacity and cert approvals.

deploy_bot: Ticket INF-6015 created: Dedicated EU provision request. ETA: 6 business days for initial cluster, +2 days for KMS and networking config.

anya_sec: Action items: produce filtered subprocessor list, create attestation template, answer SQ items. Target EOD for docs.

leo_se: I'll draft SOW and route_policy sample and post here EOD.

sam_sales: I'll send this to the prospect and ask for commitment term (12mo vs month-to-month) to lock pricing. Thanks everyone :pray:
